notes.title: Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER - Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
We’ve released the demo for Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER -, letting you experience the grand story’s opening three episodes while getting a taste of the full game’s gameplay.

As in the full game, you can freely choose your protagonist: the shrine maiden Reimu or the magician Marisa. Which perspective will you start your story from?


The full release of Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER - is just around the corner.
ー An epic journey awaits you!
Play the demo and get ready to embark on the adventure when the game launches.
